data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves at the start of 2019 were GBP 142.035m. Using the gross claims development table, prior-year development (2017 and earlier) represents an adverse movement of GBP 28.504m (approximately 20.1% of opening reserves), driven by large losses in 2019 (notably Typhoons Faxai and Hagibis on the Treaty book, a large satellite loss and the Boeing 737 Max 8 grounding) and reserve strengthening in the casualty classes. The movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle; no single gross prior-year movement note was provided.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (28.504m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross values in the notes). No single explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' numeric line was present; P&L lines labelled 'claims incurred in prior underwriting years' were deliberately not used per rules. RITC activity is noted elsewhere (2017 reinsured to close into 2018) and may distort comparisons; triangle appears consistent and was used as primary source. All monetary amounts are in the report's reporting currency (pounds sterling) and original table units were thousands.
